text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthLongevity Research Has a Bullshit ProblemHow impossible ages, lost paperwork, and invented biographies become scientific factSNBy Saul Justin Newman5:00 PM CDT on October 19, 2026Add Nautilus to Google2CommentsDebunking a case that is widely accepted by the scientific community is like seeing a piece of a movie set fall over: You realize in a moment that the saloon in the spaghetti western is not a two-­story building but a painted two-­dimensional prop made of plywood. You have the illusion of solidity in one moment, an incredulous feeling of having been tricked in the next, and after a stunned second you begin looking at the entire street thinking, “I bet that brothel’s made of cardboard.”Powered By 10 ShareNextStayI had this feeling on a regular basis once I began investigating the world’s oldest people.Read more: “The Longevity Skeptic”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
